attributes.title: Lightbox
attributes.lede: Extra fields dissolve. The plate goes home.
attributes.sample: {{! Two layoutId pairs, not one: the plate carries the tile's shape, and the LABEL travels on its own so it can grow at its own rate. Both boxes are shrink-to-fit, so they differ only in font-size — same aspect ratio, so the text scales cleanly instead of stretching. }} {{! the scrim is a plain fade — it has no counterpart to morph into }} {{photo.label}} {{! only the big version has these, so they dissolve rather than travel }}

lesson.concept: Identity survives a change of context
lesson.why: The thumbnail and detail share layout identity. The expanding content carries attention while a slower scrim establishes the modal context; the exit has a different, shorter fade.
lesson.experiment: Open two different photos and close during expansion. Compare Dreamy expansion with Quick peek and watch the background settle after the content.
lesson.pitfall: Reading the selected photo from live state during its exit can replace the departing content.
lesson.combine: Combine with presence to retain outgoing content and with camera when the original grid should stay visible.
